description: Pack an item into a container: a case, cart, box or vehicle that is itself an inventory item (e.g. the voltmeter into the experiment case). While packed, the item's location and holder FOLLOW the container: one assign_item call on the container moves or lends the whole kit, and item reads show the followed position as effectiveLocation/effectiveHolder. A container can have named compartments (a vehicle's «Fahrerhaus», «GR1»…«GR7»; get_item on the container lists them as `compartments`): `compartment` takes a name (case-insensitive) or an id; an unknown name is refused with `unknownCompartment` and the container's `validNames`. `compartment: null` puts the item directly in the container, outside any compartment (also from a compartment of the same container). Without `compartment`, re-packing into the same container keeps the item's compartment, and packing into another container puts it directly in it. Packing clears the item's own current location and holder, so an item someone holds is taken from them. Both sides must be serialized items in this organization: quantity-tracked stock goes into a container from the item's stock section in the app (it reads back as `packed` on get_item / check_item_availability). Containers nest up to three levels (compartments are not a level). Refused: lost/retired items, items reserved for an active order (also a container that holds such an item, since packing moves its contents too) and containers switched to «cannot hold items». Requires the manager role. Idempotent: re-packing into the same container and compartment changes nothing. unpack_item reverses it.

compartment.description: Compartment of the container, by name (case-insensitive) or id; null = directly in the container, outside any compartment. Absent = the current compartment (same container) or directly in another container

containerId.description: Item id of the container to pack it into

name: pack_item

compartment.description: The compartment of that container the item sits in (absent = directly in the container)

container.description: The container this item is packed into, if any

effectiveHolder.description: Holder followed through the container chain

effectiveLocation.description: Location followed through the container chain

isDraft.description: Present and true only for an unfinished draft capture

modelId.description: The item's model — pass it as create_order lines[].modelId to order any instance of this model

primaryCode.description: The code printed on the item's asset tag — how a human tells two identical models apart. Absent when no code is attached

quantity.description: How many this row stands for — only on quantity-tracked pools. To count a pool, SUM this; to count serialized items, count rows

status.description: Condition: available | in_repair | defect | lost | retired ("available" means not defect/lost/retired — the item may still be borrowed)

trackingMode.description: "quantity" for a stock pool counted by amount. Absent = a serialized item, i.e. this row IS one physical thing

webUrl.description: Link to this item in the web app, for a person to open. Absent when the deployment has no public address configured

title: Pack item into container
